Position Summary...







What you'll do...Role summary:


 The Senior Director, Data Analytics leads the development and execution of advanced data strategies to drive business insights and operational excellence. This role oversees data quality, analytics, and visualization initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and delivering measurable impact. By leveraging expertise in big data and exploratory analysis, the position guides cross-functional teams to identify root causes, optimize data sources, and implement scalable solutions. The Senior Director fosters a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and strategic decision-making to support Walmart’s growth and technology-driven transformation. 

About the team:


 Walmart Connect leads Walmart’s growth by powering its closed-loop media business within the world’s largest omnichannel retailer. The Data Analytics team drives strategic insights through advanced data strategy, quality management, and big data analytics. This team applies robust analytical methods and visualization techniques to solve complex business challenges, enabling data-driven decisions that enhance performance. Collaborating across functions, the team ensures data integrity and accessibility while delivering impactful solutions. Members leverage expertise in analytics, data quality, and visualization to support Walmart’s commitment to innovation and operational excellence in a dynamic retail environment.

 Proficiency in data visualization tools and techniques to communicate complex data insights clearly and influence stakeholders.

jobs_results.description:
We are partnering with a data-driven consumer business seeking a Senior Manager, Data & Analytics to lead a multidisciplinary data team and act as a strategic partner to senior leadership.

This is a highly visible leadership position combining team management, stakeholder engagement, analytics, business intelligence, and data strategy. The successful candidate will help shape how data is used across the organisation, driving better decision-making through actionable insights and scalable analytical capabilities.

This role would suit an experienced analytics leader who enjoys operating in a player-coach capacity, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on involvement where needed.

The Opportunity
You will lead a small team spanning multiple data disciplines and serve as the primary point of contact for data and analytics across the business.

The role requires someone who can translate complex business questions into analytical solutions, influence senior stakeholders through evidence-based recommendations, and build a high-performing data function that supports commercial growth and operational effectiveness.

Success in this position will come from the ability to combine strong leadership, commercial acumen, analytical thinking, and technical credibility.

Key Responsibilities
Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team covering analytics, business intelligence, reporting, and data management.

Establish clear ownership, priorities, and accountability across the team.

Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivery excellence.

Act as a player-coach, providing guidance while remaining close enough to the work to unblock challenges and support key initiatives.

Business Partnership

Partner directly with senior business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives.

Translate business needs into actionable data and analytics initiatives.

Provide thought leadership and challenge assumptions through data-driven insights.

Influence decision-making through effective communication and storytelling.

Analytics & Insights

Drive analysis across customer, commercial, operational, and financial performance.

Identify opportunities, risks, trends, and areas for improvement.

Deliver meaningful recommendations that lead to measurable business outcomes.

Establish and evolve KPI frameworks that support organisational performance.

Data & Reporting

Oversee reporting, data quality, governance, and analytical processes.

Partner closely with technical teams to ensure scalable and sustainable data solutions.

Improve analytics capabilities, reporting structures, and business visibility into performance.

Support adoption of modern analytical approaches, including AI-enabled tooling and predictive analytics where appropriate.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and decision-making through technology.

Required Experience

6+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, or related disciplines.

Previous people leadership experience, including team development and performance management.

Experience leading broad data functions rather than a single specialist discipline.

A proven track record of partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions.

Experience working within fast-paced, data-rich business environments.

Technical Requirements

Advanced SQL proficiency.

Strong experience with modern BI and visualisation platforms such as Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

Understanding of data pipelines, data transformation processes, reporting environments, and data quality principles.

Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and engineering teams.

jobs_results.description:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com.



In Consulting we work with C-suite executives, leaders and boards of the world’s leading organizations, helping them reinvent every part of their enterprise to drive greater growth, enhance competitiveness, implement operational improvements, reduce cost, deliver sustainable 360° stakeholder value, and set a new performance frontier for themselves and the industry in which they operate. Our deep industry and functional expertise are supported by proprietary assets and solutions that help organizations transform faster and become more resilient. 



Our AI and Data Strategy practitioners work to create and execute an organizations business strategy for AI and Data transformation including: defining a compelling industry vision, creating value models, architecting a client’s talent strategy, ecosystem partnership approaches, creating scalable operating, envisioning best-in-class business/technology architecture & roadmaps. Use scaled agile disciplines to transform around iterative approach sequencing use cases focused on critical data elements aligned to data product and platform feature development.



As an AI & Data Strategy Manager, you will:

Shape vision and create opportunities for AI, GenAI and data led business reinvention.

Build client relationships and credibility as a trusted advisor on how to infuse AI, GenAI and data into the business processes or functions    

Define and structure an organization’s AI and data strategy to build and optimize data assets, AI technologies for growth & competitive advantages.

Assess maturity of an organization’s AI and Data strategy, talent, operating model, ways of working and data foundation

Define building blocks required to convert to an AI-first organization, including technology and AI platform blueprint, data strategy and future-ready operating model.

Create the business case, investment profile and roadmap to deliver on the strategy (including revenue upside as well as cost-takeout opportunities).

Infuse Responsible AI in vision and roadmap, develop plan for leveraging ecosystem partners, and define operating model to foster a culture of innovation and experimentation.

Identify people, processes, and technologies to develop and operationalize AI solutions.

Create strategy for AI-first products and develop commercialization opportunities.



Ability to travel up to 80%; travel as needed based on client expectations.

This role sits within the Data Product function and reports to the Senior Director, Data Product

This leader is responsible not only for defining and delivering high-impact data products, but also for coaching and guiding a team of Product Managers, ensuring consistency in product thinking, execution quality, and value delivery across the portfolio
The Senior Product Manager operates at both strategic and execution levels, shaping product direction, aligning with enterprise priorities, and ensuring teams deliver measurable business outcomes
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, brings strong product judgment, and understands how to scale product practices across teams building data and AI solutions
Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership
Own and evolve a portfolio-level product strategy spanning data products, semantic layers, ML-enabled solutions, and data services
Align product investments with our enterprise priorities and Data & AI strategy, ensuring focus on highest-value opportunities
Define and track portfolio-level KPIs and value realization, ensuring products drive measurable impact across Operations, Planning, Safety, Finance, and beyond
Identify and prioritize opportunities across teams, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform and product strategy
Serve as a senior thought partner to Data & AI leadership on product direction, sequencing, and trade-offs

Establish and reinforce best practices for product management, including problem definition, roadmap development, backlog management, and stakeholder engagement

Support PMs in navigating ambiguity, stakeholder complexity, and cross-functional dependencies
Elevate the overall product maturity of the Data Product function, contributing to standards, playbooks, and operating models

Product Definition & Execution Oversight
Ensure clear, well-defined product strategies and roadmaps across all owned products
Guide teams in translating business needs into structured problem statements and actionable requirements
Partner with Data Engineering, BI, and Data Science leads to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned to platform standards
Maintain accountability for what is built and why, while empowering PMs to own day-to-day execution
Step in on complex or high-impact initiatives to provide hands-on product leadership when needed
Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Leadership
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across business functions to shape demand and align on priorities
Ensure consistent engagement models across PMs, reducing fragmentation and improving stakeholder experience
Coordinate across teams to manage dependencies, sequencing, and shared platform considerations
Act as an escalation point for complex product or stakeholder challenges
Ensure products are intuitive, workflow-aligned, and embedded in how our team operates
Drive a culture of continuous feedback, iteration, and adoption tracking across all products
Hold teams accountable for delivering measurable business outcomes, not just outputs
Champion product decisions that balance usability, scalability, and long-term maintainability
Governance, Quality & Standards
Ensure adherence to data governance, semantic modeling, and metric standards across the product portfolio
Partner with BI and Data Science leadership to uphold analytical rigor and model governance
Promote consistent documentation of product decisions, assumptions, and trade-offs
Drive alignment to data-as-a-product principles and reusable data asset development

Own and evolve Agile delivery ways of working for the product team by establishing and improving standards for sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, dependency management, and continuous improvement

Maintain and continuously improve the Jira operating environment for the Data team, including workflow design, board structure, issue hierarchy, taxonomy/metadata standards, reporting, traceability, and team adoption of consistent delivery practices
